baseline_models.focus_anchor: صِرَاطٍ and the ق و م formation in مُسْتَقِيمٍ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The road image supplies a traversable course, while straightness, moderation, and evenness specify its internal alignment. The construction عَلَى places the subject not merely near a direction but stably upon it.

activation_trace.role: A road, especially a straight road, supplies the spatial course.
Straightness, moderation, and evenness make that course aligned rather than merely available.

changed_reading.before: The phrase only locates someone on a road.
changed_reading.after: The phrase locates someone within an evenly aligned course whose form itself resists deviation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The road noun joined to the care and qiwam branches of ق و م in مُسْتَقِيمٍ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A course can be straight because an ordering function preserves it and supplies what keeps it standing. The path is therefore not only a line to follow but a maintained, load-bearing regime for conduct.

activation_trace.role: The road image supplies the ordered domain in which movement occurs.
Care, preservation, and governance make the road an order that must be maintained.
Qiwam as support and livelihood makes the maintained order load-bearing for life and action.

changed_reading.before: Straightness is a visible property of the route.
changed_reading.after: Straightness is the sustained order that keeps a way and its traveler standing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The cutting branch of ص ر ط and the rising-to-an-undertaking branch of ق و م.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sword image makes the course penetrating and decisive, while rising with resolve makes it an undertaking rather than a passive location. Together they permit an active, obstacle-piercing reading of being upon the path.

activation_trace.role: The cutting, penetrating sword image turns the course into decisive advance through resistance.
Rising with resolve to an undertaking supplies active execution rather than static position.

changed_reading.before: The subject occupies a correct route.
changed_reading.after: The subject is engaged in an upright, decisively advancing undertaking.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The swallowing-passage branch of ص ر ط held in alignment by مُسْتَقِيمٍ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The route can be imagined as a conduit through which what enters passes and disappears, while the ق و م branch prevents that passage from becoming directionless. The phrase can thus describe an aligned medium of transit.

activation_trace.role: Swallowing and disappearance in passage make the road a conduit that takes movement through itself.
Evenness and straightness keep the absorptive passage directed rather than chaotic.

changed_reading.before: A traveler moves over an external road.
changed_reading.after: A directed passage receives and conveys the traveler through itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recitation, exact construction, dispatch, delivered descent, and arrival of a message form an ordered relay around the focus. The messenger's being upon the straight path becomes fidelity within a transmission line from source to recipient.

activation_trace.role: Preservation and watchful maintenance anchor straightness as fidelity within the relay.
Reading, recitation, and causing to be read supply the transmissible verbal content.
Exact construction and secure workmanship make preservation of form part of the relay.
Dispatch and being sent place the focus subject inside a commissioned movement.
Causing something to descend and reach its recipient supplies the source-to-messenger leg.
Conveying the message supplies the relay's required arrival rather than merely its departure.

structural_cues: 36:2-5 place 36:4 between a recited, securely formed source, a sent messenger, and a delivered descent.
36:17 restricts the messengers' task to clear delivery, sharpening path-straightness as transmission fidelity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recitation, exactness, sending, descent, and delivery; I supply the arrow that treats them as one fidelity-preserving relay. A live alternative is that they frame an ordinary moral path without describing its mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The messenger stands on an aligned moral route.
changed_reading.after: The messenger occupies and enacts a source-to-recipient line whose straightness is faithful delivery.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly leaves a course conceptually present while disabling sight, erasing visual capacity, or removing forward and reverse movement. Straightness therefore does not guarantee access; a path functions only through a relation among course, perception, posture, and locomotion.

activation_trace.role: Alignment supplies the objectively ordered course whose accessibility is being tested.
Failure of ocular seeing shows that an aligned course can remain operationally unavailable.
Loss of light and sight removes the perceptual interface needed to use the course.
Racing and trying to precede intensify motion toward the path while sight is absent.
The explicit road remains the target, separating path-existence from the traveler's access to it.
Passage and forward penetration name the locomotion that can be withdrawn.
Return is also removed, closing both directions and exposing bodily capacity as part of traversal.

structural_cues: 36:8-9 surround failed sight with collars, forced head posture, and barriers before and behind.
36:66-67 explicitly juxtapose racing to the path with erased sight, then deny both advance and return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies barriers, failed sight, a race toward the path, and loss of two-way movement; I infer that traversability is a relational affordance rather than geometry alone. The scenes can alternatively be read as moral refusal depicted through bodily images.

changed_reading.before: A straight path is usable because its direction is objectively correct.
changed_reading.after: A straight path becomes usable only when the traveler can perceive, orient, and move within its alignment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Following is rendered as tracking after prior traces; a man crosses purposefully from the city's far edge and calls others to follow the guided messengers. The focus course becomes a socially transmissible itinerary, instantiated by movement from the margin rather than an abstract line announced from the center.

activation_trace.role: Rising with resolve makes the focus path an undertaking capable of being enacted and copied.
Tracking trace after trace turns following the reminder into movement along an inherited itinerary.
The farthest side supplies a spatial margin from which alignment can enter the communal scene.
Purposeful movement toward a sought end embodies the path as active pursuit.
Coming after and following transfers the messenger's course to prospective followers.
Gentle indication toward road and truth identifies the messengers as usable guides, not just speakers.

structural_cues: 36:11 joins receptivity to following, while 36:20-21 stages running, exhortation to follow, and the followers' guidance in sequence.
The runner comes from the farthest part of the city, making peripheral-to-communal movement salient.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies trace-following, distance, purposeful running, renewed following, and road-guidance; I connect them as one transferable itinerary. They may instead be separate narrative actions that only exemplify prior guidance.

changed_reading.before: The focus path is an individual upright stance.
changed_reading.after: It is a trail enacted by a mover, recoverable trace by trace, and passed onward to a community.

context_deltas.mechanism: What people advance leaves durable traces that are exhaustively counted in a leading, legible register; later, stationary bodies are stirred, rush from graves, gather, and are brought present. The path expands into a temporal itinerary whose movement is recorded and whose terminus is re-standing for presentation.

activation_trace.role: Resurrection and the rising of creatures provide the focus root's terminal standing event.
Advance toward the front turns deeds into forward movement along the temporal course.
A durable sign of what was leaves the itinerary readable after the mover has passed.
Enumeration and exhaustive reckoning make every segment and effect accountable.
The leading exemplar supplies a register that both contains the trace and points ahead.
Sudden rushing and rapid passage reactivate movement at resurrection.
Stirring the stationary from rest supplies the transition from dormancy to renewed travel.
Gathering dispersed persons gives the many itineraries a common terminus.
Presence, nearness, and witnessing name arrival at that terminus.

structural_cues: 36:12 binds revival, what was advanced, surviving traces, complete enumeration, and a clear imam in one sentence.
36:51-53 then sequences emergence from graves, awakening, rushing, gathering, and presence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a trace-led register and a later awakening-to-presence sequence; I infer that both describe one temporal path from action to presentation. A live alternative keeps the ledger and resurrection scenes parallel rather than causally continuous.

changed_reading.before: The path names the subject's correct location in the present.
changed_reading.after: The path is an inscribed itinerary: advances persist as traces and culminate in renewed standing and collective presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sun flows toward a fixed station, the moon is measured through stages and returns, and all bodies swim in a rotating course without overtaking one another. Straightness is recast as exact fidelity to assigned measure, sequence, and boundary, so a straight course need not be geometrically rectilinear.

activation_trace.role: The road image supplies the course whose geometry is being reconsidered.
Evenness and right proportion allow straightness to mean regulated fit, not only an uncurved line.
Flowing and continuous movement make the celestial path dynamically traversed.
Fixity and settlement give the flowing course a stable station or bound.
Deliberate measurement and ordering supply the rule that governs motion.
Return after departure makes recurrence compatible with a faithful course.
Precedence and racing, here negated between cycles, define a non-collision boundary.
The celestial circuit supplies an explicitly curved yet ordered track.
Swimming and running supply self-consistent motion within that circuit.

structural_cues: 36:38-40 form a continuous sequence of flow, station, measure, stages, return, non-overtaking, orbit, and swimming.
The sequence combines stable limits with ongoing and recurrent motion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured celestial motions and non-overtaking circuits; I infer that they redefine the focus adjective as rule-fidelity rather than Euclidean shape. They may instead be analogies of power that leave the path's geometry untouched.

changed_reading.before: Straightness means following an unbending line.
changed_reading.after: Straightness means remaining exactly within an assigned measure and sequence, even through return and curvature.

context_deltas.mechanism: A loaded vessel carries descendants, analogous mounts are ridden, and the surrounding medium can engulf them unless rescue and mercy preserve passage. The path becomes a load-bearing carrier one is borne upon, while the absorptive ص ر ط branch marks the danger that the medium of passage can instead swallow the traveler.

activation_trace.role: Swallowing and disappearance in passage make transit capable of turning into engulfment.
Support and qiwam make the course a bearing structure rather than empty space.
Lifting and bearing a visible load supply the carrier function.
The ship circling through water gives the path a vessel-like material form.
Filling and loading stress that the course bears a dense collective cargo.
Riding on the back of a carrier shifts traversal from self-propulsion to being borne.
Drowning in water realizes the negative pole of an absorptive medium.
Extraction from peril identifies rescue as restoration of passage.
Merciful tenderness supplies the preserving condition that keeps carriage from becoming engulfment.

structural_cues: 36:41-44 move without interruption from carrying in a loaded vessel, to rideable analogues, to drowning, rescue, mercy, and a limited term.
The focus construction عَلَى readily supports the image of being borne upon a carrier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies carriage, riding, engulfment, rescue, and mercy; I infer that these materialize the focus path as a bearing medium. A live alternative treats the maritime sequence as a separate sign with no lexical pressure on صراط.

changed_reading.before: The traveler advances along the path by personal locomotion.
changed_reading.after: The traveler is borne by a supporting course that can convey, engulf, or be mercifully kept open.

context_deltas.mechanism: A preserved covenant forbids service to what distances and bends away, then directly identifies service to God as a straight path. The worship branch supplies obedient enactment, while the same root's leveling branch suggests that repeated service makes conduct traversable; straightness is a maintained covenantal practice, not merely a recognized direction.

activation_trace.role: The road image anchors the later explicit equation back in the focus phrase.
Ongoing care and maintenance make covenantal alignment something preserved over time.
A preserved covenant supplies the binding frame within which the path is enacted.
Submissive worship, here prohibited toward Satan, defines service as directional allegiance.
Distance and severance supply the opposed motion away from covenantal alignment.
Submissive worship supplies the practice explicitly equated with the road.
Subjection and leveling make service function as the smoothing of conduct into a traversable way.
The repeated road noun explicitly identifies the practice as the focus kind of course.
Repeated straightness, moderation, and evenness confirm the full focus phrase.
Deviation from guidance supplies the path's explicit contrary.
Reason as a restraint against ignorance supplies the faculty that should block deviation.

structural_cues: 36:60-61 moves directly from covenant and a prohibition on worship to a positive worship command followed by هَذَا صِرَاطٌ مُسْتَقِيمٌ.
36:62 immediately contrasts that path with mass leading-astray and failure to reason.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The direct equation of worship and straight path is supplied; I additionally connect the leveling branch of ع ب د and the maintenance branch of ق و م into a practice that smooths and preserves conduct. The alternative is a pure allegiance definition without this process image.

changed_reading.before: The straight path is a norm that the traveler recognizes and chooses.
changed_reading.after: The straight path is exclusive covenantal service repeatedly enacted, leveled into habit, and guarded against severing deviation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence moves from a drop to a disputing person, from forgotten origin to decayed bone, from first production to renewed life, from green plant matter to ignited fire, and from command to being and return. The focus path becomes continuity of origination through radical material reversals, with ق و م's resurrection branch marking renewed standing after apparent discontinuity.

activation_trace.role: The road supplies the continuous line along which discontinuous material states are related.
Resurrection and renewed standing anchor the line's return from decay.
A clear drop extending through scales up to generative fluid supplies the minute material origin.
Loss of remembrance breaks the person's perceived continuity with that origin.
Decay and worn remains supply the apparently terminal material discontinuity.
Bringing a thing into existence supplies the generative operation that can be repeated.
Beginning and precedence make first origination the reference point for renewed creation.
Fresh green plant matter supplies one pole of a counterintuitive material transition.
Ignition supplies the opposed fiery state produced from the green material.
Coming to be and becoming present supply the immediate conversion from command to actuality.
Return to what preceded closes the generative line as a directed homecoming.

structural_cues: 36:77-79 explicitly opposes remembered first origin to decayed bone and renewed animation.
36:80 inserts green tree to fire as a compact reversal, while 36:82-83 close with command, being, and return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequence of origins, decay, re-creation, material reversal, coming-to-be, and return; I supply the arrow that treats these as one invariant course of agency. A live alternative takes them as independent proofs rather than a model of the focus path.

changed_reading.before: A straight path preserves the traveler's recognizable state while moving toward an end.
changed_reading.after: A straight path can be continuity of origin and return across states as discontinuous as drop, person, bone, decay, life, green matter, and fire.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because قَوْم, the people branch, is form-distant from the adjectival مُسْتَقِيم and should not be substituted into its translation. It remains root-anchored because the focus contains ق و م and the surah repeatedly reactivates the exact root as addressed, erring, and remembered communities. Downstream prose should present it as a social root echo, not as a lexical definition.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ق و م root inside مُسْتَقِيمٍ.

activation_trace.role: The people or communal branch makes collective formation latent inside the focus root.
The first warned people activate the path as addressed to a collective rather than isolated travelers.
A people characterized by excess show collective shape diverging from alignment.
The runner's address to his people makes guidance an attempt to realign a community.
Continued concern for his people after his own passage keeps communal alignment as the unresolved object.

changed_reading.before: Straightness concerns an individual's relation to a route.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the course also stands a people into coherence and is disclosed by their collective response to guidance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the standing-but-sightless eye is an idiomatic edge branch of ق و م, not the direct sense of مُسْتَقِيم. It remains valid as a counterimage because blindness frames the road in 36:9 and eye-erasure is placed beside racing to the road in 36:66. Downstream prose should use it diagnostically to unsettle visual uprightness, never as a translation of the adjective.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ق و م root in مُسْتَقِيمٍ, through its branch for an intact-looking eye whose sight is gone.

activation_trace.role: An eye that remains physically standing while sight is lost supplies the paradox of intact form without function.
Absent ocular seeing activates the focus root's sightless-eye counterimage.
Erasure of light and sight makes functional loss explicit even before the road is named.
The road remains present beside blindness, allowing upright appearance and path-access to come apart.

changed_reading.before: Visible uprightness is evidence that the traveler is correctly aligned.
changed_reading.after: An intact, standing form may still be blind; operative straightness requires perception, not merely upright appearance.

strongest_changes: The static road became a fidelity-preserving messenger relay and a trace-followed social itinerary.
Objective geometry became embodied accessibility: sight, orientation, and two-way movement can make an existing path unusable.
Straightness became measured course-fidelity compatible with recurrence, orbit, and swimming rather than only an uncurved line.
The path became an inscribed resurrection itinerary joining advanced deeds and lasting traces to renewed rising, gathering, and presence.
The explicit recurrence in 36:61 made covenantal worship an enacted and maintained path, while the vessel and creation sequences kept carried passage and material return live beside it.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly placed the focus roots beside sending, following, blockage, trace, orbit, carriage, resurrection, and a second explicit صراط مستقيم. This activated distant but coherent branches without forcing them into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The cosmic, maritime, and material sequences may illuminate the path analogically rather than define its mechanism.
The collective قَوْم echo and the standing-but-blind eye are visibly anchored but form-distant and require explicit exploratory containment.
The relay, ledger-to-resurrection, and origination-to-return arrows are reader-supplied syntheses across packet sequences.
